lookInOneLine: White space, heavy grotesk type, big daylight photos and one cobalt accent: crisp and confident like a modern product site, but warm.

contrastMethod: WCAG 2.x relative luminance formula, computed with a short Node script. Every body text pair is 4.5:1 or better.

display.notes: Variable font with an optical size axis (font-optical-sizing: auto). Headlines tracked tight, -2.4% to -3.6%. Wordmark at -4.5%. Line height 0.92 to 1.05.

body.notes: Body 17px / 1.6, lead 19px / 1.55, labels 12.5px caps +14%. Lining figures everywhere. Chosen in review over Instrument Sans, which the Bold & Dark look also uses, so no two looks share a body face.

scale.name: Display M (titles that share a row)

shapes.rules: 1px #DCE2EC hairlines between items and around cards; 1.5px borders on outline buttons and inputs
shapes.accentLines: Label line 22px x 2px cobalt; next-step and numbered-row marks 3px that draw full width then settle to 14%; 3px cobalt line under card photos on hover; 2px scroll progress line under the header
shapes.shadows: Neutral ink shadows only, used on floating things (dropdown, chat, hero chip). No colored glows.

motion.character: Crisp and quick, like good product UI. Short rises on a firm ease-out, cobalt lines that draw like a progress bar, a ticker-style word swap, and one slow daylight drift on the hero photo. Nothing bounces, nothing glows.
motion.easing: cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) for arrivals, cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) for hovers
pieces: Scroll reveal: blocks rise 18px and fade in over 0.8s. JS adds reveal-init only after the observer exists, then swaps to reveal-in.
Next-step columns and cards arrive one by one, 0.09s apart.
Accent line draws across each column (0 to full) and settles to a short 14% mark.
Hover: a Cobalt Press panel wipes up behind a next-step column; the title nudges 4px; the arrow slides.
Primary buttons: one light sheen when they first scroll into view, and a soft light that follows the cursor inside the button.
Hero word swaps like a ticker: the old word exits up and is fully gone before the new one rises in.
Announcement play button: a cobalt ring pulses gently outward.
Hero photo drifts and zooms slowly over 28 seconds in place of a film.
Mission highlighter draws in behind one phrase.
Photo strip scrolls slowly (80s loop), pauses on hover, and has a Pause Photos button.
Reviews rotate on a 6.5s progress line under the quote that pauses on hover or focus. The old review is gone before the next one rises in, so they never overlap.
Statement band sky drifts 56px with scroll (parallax).
Header hairline appears on scroll with a cobalt reading-progress line.
motion.reducedMotion: Under prefers-reduced-motion every animation and transition stops, the hero word stays on 'people.', the strip becomes a still, scrollable row, and reviews only change by button.

photoTreatment.source: Unsplash License stock photos (no Unsplash+) plus one Pexels License photo, credited in photos/CREDITS.md
photoTreatment.grade: Bright daylight, clean whites, cool open shadows, true skin. No orange tint, heavy filters or vignettes.
photoTreatment.subjects: Groups of adults in real moments: friends over coffee, worship in a bright room, greeting, small group, prayer, volunteers sorting donations, baptism, a pastor teaching.
photoTreatment.framing: Big crops with room around people, set in 10px corners. The hero bleeds to the right edge of the screen on desktop and sits first on phones.
photoTreatment.textOnPhotos: Only on the statement band (deep blue sky) and social posts, always over a night ink fade so white type stays above 4.5:1.
photoTreatment.cropsToAvoidText: pastor-teaching.jpg is cropped below projected slide words; families-greeting-lobby.jpg is cropped right of the letters on the glass.

logo.concept: A lightwell seen in section. A shaft of light drops through the roof of a rounded cobalt square and lands as a floor, drawing a white L. A small sky-tint pane at top right is the sky above.
logo.mark: 40 x 40 rounded square (radius 9), cobalt #1F4FFF; white L made of a 6.5-unit shaft from the top edge and a 6.5-unit floor; Sky #E4ECFF pane 7.5 units square.
lockups: Stacked: mark above wordmark, CHURCH · RALEIGH in spaced caps below
Small mark alone for avatars and favicon (down to 16px)
Reversed: white square with cobalt L on cobalt, ink or photos
logo.clearSpace: Equal to the sky pane on every side
logo.builtIn: Inline SVG symbol plus live type, so it scales cleanly and edits easily

files.photos: photos/ (14 JPEGs at 1800px wide, quality 80) and photos/CREDITS.md
